ques: Search the antitrust press releases for the May 2026 announcement about Bayer's corn and soybean seed loyalty program. What is the program's name, what two different restrictions did Bayer remove, and what is the press-release number?

Find the antitrust press release announcing DOJ's April 2025 victory against Google in open-web digital advertising. Report the publication date, the separate updated date, and the trial's duration and month/year.

Compare the July 8, 2025 antitrust whistleblower-program announcement with the January 29, 2026 first-payment release. What maximum reward percentage did the launch announce, what minimum recovery and award range does the later release specify, and what two remedial obligations did EBLOCK undertake in addition to its fine?

In the September 21, 2026 fraud press release about Crown Medical Solutions, identify the alleged billing period, the whistleblower's name and approximate settlement share, and whether the release says liability was determined.

Find the September 17, 2026 fraud release about the Arizona addiction-treatment clinic owner. Give the clinic's name, the approximate period of fraudulent billing, the specific health plan the scheme targeted, and the action used to obstruct the investigation after a subpoena arrived.

Find DOJ's September 16, 2026 antitrust release about relief against Google. Identify the two product pairs that must integrate with Prebid, what publishers must be allowed to do with their own data, and how long monitor and technical-committee oversight will last.

In DOJ Legal Careers, find the California U.S. Trustee Program Trial Attorney (Bankruptcy) vacancy posted September 25, 2026. Report its Job ID, the available field-office cities, and the minimum post-J.D. experience listed for each advertised grade.

Find the BOP Consolidated Legal Center Attorney vacancy in California posted September 25, 2026. Distinguish its two possible duty locations from the four correctional institutions covered by the Los Angeles legal team, and report the salary grades stated in the posting.

Compare the California BOP Consolidated Legal Center Attorney and UST Trial Attorney (Bankruptcy) vacancies posted September 25, 2026. For each, summarize the application documents, any resume or writing-sample length limits stated in its Application Process section, and the relocation-expense policy. Include the UST instructions for packaging the application and identifying preferred field offices; do not submit an application.

Compare the Criminal Division's ICHIP Netherlands and Resident Legal Advisor Albania detail vacancies posted September 22, 2026. For each, report the planned assignment length and start timing, the embassy city, and the travel expectation. Also identify the security clearance both postings require.

Find the Trial Attorney (Public Trust and Financial Integrity Section) vacancy updated September 23, 2026. List its six duty-location cities, the date by which rolling application review would begin, and the required email subject-line format. Do not send an application.

From the DOJ office directory, locate U.S. Trustee Region 16's permanent-closure notice for Woodland Hills. Report the effective closure date and the destination office, mailing address, and phone number specified in that notice for documents and correspondence.

Navigate through U.S. Trustee Region 16 to the Los Angeles office's Local Section 341 Meeting Information for the Los Angeles Division. For the chapter 7, 12, and 13 video-meeting rollout, give the case-filing cutoff and meeting-start date. Then state how chapter 11 meetings are held and which sections of Official Form 309 provide joining information for ordinary chapter 11 and subchapter V cases.

Use the U.S. Trustee office directory to compare Region 16's Santa Ana and Riverside field offices. For each office, report the Assistant United States Trustee, the full mailing address including suite, the office phone number, and the division served.

On the U.S. Trustee Program's Chapter 11 Operating Reports page, locate the instructions for both the Monthly Operating Report and Post-confirmation Report. Give each document's exact title, download link, and the modification date shown in the Instructions table; distinguish these from the form download rows.

A Mac user preparing a Post-confirmation Report gets the message 'An error occurred during the submit process. There was a problem connecting to the server' when generating the court-filing PDF. Use the UST operating-reports page and its Troubleshooting Tips to identify the Mac-specific PCR download link, the two instructions under that exact error, and the minimum Adobe Reader and operating-system requirements for the Mac form.

In UST's MOR/PCR Troubleshooting Tips, find the PCR question whose error is exactly 'Error: Nothing Done' without 'Unknown Format'. Report its two corrective steps, whether Generate PDF for Court Filing and Remove Watermark files the PDF with the court, and the page's updated date.

Find OIP's instructions for requests or appeals submitted before January 28, 2020. Open the legacy-information section and identify the prior portal, the complete requester-service-center mailing address and phone for status information or uploaded documents, and how OIP says it will respond to requests or appeals that were pending on January 29, 2020.

Use DOJ's FOIA contact directory to find the Office of the Solicitor General. Report its FOIA email address, the mailing address including room number, and the named public liaison with that liaison's phone number.

Find the FOIA Requester Service Center phone for the Executive Office for U.S. Attorneys in DOJ's contact directory. Then use OIP's administrative-appeal guidance to explain what identifies the original request, the appeal filing deadline and its starting event, and how multiple original requests should be handled. Report the guidance only; do not submit a request or appeal.
